description: Changes one forwarded address at a site's domain: the inbox its email goes to, or the address itself (new_mailbox), as Change in the domain's settings does. Only owners and admins. A new inbox gets an email from Cloudflare (the service that carries the mail) with a link to confirm it, and nothing reaches it until someone there chooses Verify email address; the answer names that inbox (confirmationEmailSentTo). Tell the person who will get that email.

destination.description: The inbox the mail goes to, outside the domain, such as you@gmail.com.

domain.description: The domain, as list_email_forwarding lists it, such as acme.com.

mailbox.description: The address to change, as list_email_forwarding lists it: the part before the @ (info for info@acme.com), or * for every address no other line names.

new_mailbox.description: Its new address; omit to keep it: the part before the @ (info for info@acme.com), or * for every address no other line names.

reason.description: Why, in a sentence: kept in the workspace's activity.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: change_email_forwarding
title: Change a forwarded address
